cases.name: diag_pass_rate_2sticks
cases.what: both sticks as mouse: 120 counts/ms asked, at most 127 per pass

cases.name: diag_pass_rate_ls
cases.what: LS mouse far past 127 counts per pass: dx / 127 = passes

cases.name: diag_pass_rate_ls_touch
cases.what: the same with the right pad touched and moving (pad scans wake the loop)

cases.name: diag_flick_180
cases.what: RS flick stick, 180 degrees: the turn's counts per step

cases.name: diag_pass_gaps
cases.what: shift by A / B in steps of 7..17 ms: each change shows up in the first pass after the step edge

cases.name: diag_soft_shift
cases.what: shift by the LT soft pull: how many passes after the pull it engages

cases.name: diag_haptic_stall_click
cases.what: A plays a click haptic, B (a shift) 2 ms later: is the loop held up by the haptic?

cases.name: diag_haptic_stall_strong
cases.what: A plays a strong haptic, B (a shift) 2 ms later: is the loop held up by the haptic?

cases.name: diag_haptic_stall_none
cases.what: A plays a none haptic, B (a shift) 2 ms later: is the loop held up by the haptic?

cases.name: diag_gyro_load_always
cases.what: gyro mouse always: when B's shift reaches the remapper

cases.name: diag_gyro_load_off
cases.what: gyro mouse off: when B's shift reaches the remapper
